summary: Round 28 testing — verified WallProspettoEditor modal flow (open / electrical tool / click-to-add / 180° flip / delete) and Viewer3D MEP rendering on project 51845afe-0ba4-4c58-837b-e08808c32a6a. Backend project payload exposes electrical/plumbing/hvac arrays with wall_side, phase, kind, height_cm fields (admin login OK via cookies, GET /api/projects/<id> returns expected schema). Modal opens, electrical points are added with correct toast 'electrical aggiunto a t=XX% h=YYcm su Lato A', Lato A counter increments from 4→5, 180° flip switches header to 'B (dietro)' and clears visible markers. Delete trash buttons render per entry. 3D viewer renders MEP markers (3 visible blue cubes/spheres on the back wall in 3D scene). No console runtime errors, no 'setWallProspettoId is not defined' errors. The 'A pavimento' Switch exists in Editor.jsx line 1726 but uses dynamic testid `${kind}-floor-toggle` (e.g. presa-floor-toggle / acqua-floor-toggle) — NOT the static 'electrical-floor-toggle' mentioned in the test request. Code itself is correct, only the testid documentation in the review_request is stale.

issues: Modal is wide (max-w-6xl) and on 1920px screen the right-hand Properties panel is still visible behind the overlay — fine functionally but cluttered. Backdrop click closes modal correctly.

test_report_links: /app/frontend/src/pages/Editor.jsx (state wallProspettoId, openWallProspetto prop wiring verified at lines 116, 990, 1046, 1189, 1397)
action_items: Align data-testid for the 'A pavimento' Switch: review_request expects 'electrical-floor-toggle' / 'plumbing-floor-toggle' but Editor.jsx line 1726 emits `${kind}-floor-toggle` (presa-floor-toggle, acqua-floor-toggle, luce-floor-toggle, hvac-floor-toggle, ...). Either rename to a stable testid like 'mep-floor-toggle' (preferred — easier to test) or update the spec.
Consider adding data-testid='wpe-toast' or similar marker to the Sonner toast for deterministic Playwright assertions (currently relies on [data-sonner-toast] global selector).

Wall selection requires clicking the inner <line>/<rect> child of the wall <g> — clicking the parent <g data-testid='wall-...'> sometimes doesn't trigger the onClick (only worked when forcing a click on the child shape). Consider attaching the onClick handler at the <g> level or making the <g> pointer-events:bounding-box.
critical_code_review_comments: WallProspettoEditor.jsx (218 LOC) is clean, single-responsibility. Good use of useMemo for points filtering and props-based openWallProspetto callback.
STD_HEIGHTS map is duplicated inline (line 64) — also exists in Viewer3D renderMep; consider extracting to a shared constants module so 2D/3D/prospetto stay in sync.
addPoint() picks `wall_side: currentSide` (-1 or +1) — consistent with backend persisted sample electrical (wall_side=-1). Good.
Editor.jsx still 2702 lines — exceeds 700 LOC threshold; split into Toolbar / PropertiesPanel / modals subfiles for maintainability.

Toggling the tool button OFF after flip can surprise users — once you select Electrical and flip 180°, clicking 'Elettrico' again deselects the tool. Acceptable behaviour but could be documented in the helper text above the prospetto.
ProspettoClickable handler clamps height to [5, H-5] which prevents adding points outside the wall — correct.

success_rate.backend: 100% (login + project GET returning expected MEP schema with all required fields)
success_rate.frontend: WPE open/add/flip/delete: 100% verified; 3D MEP rendering: PASS (markers visible); floor-toggle UI: NOT tested via Playwright due to dynamic testid (code-reviewed — Switch exists at line 1726)

seed_data_creation: Added 1 electrical 'presa' point on Lato A of wall via UI during testing (t=30%, h=162cm). Original project had 3 electrical + 4 hvac entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All listed P0/P1 features for Round 28 are working: modal open, add point, flip, delete buttons, save persistence, 3D MEP rendering. The only mismatch is the 'A pavimento' Switch data-testid pattern (dynamic `${kind}-floor-toggle` instead of static names). To test floor-toggle: in 2D click an electrical element with [data-testid^='elec-'], then look for switch with testid matching the element kind (e.g. 'presa-floor-toggle'). Wall selection requires force-clicking the inner <line> child of the wall <g>, not the <g> itself.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs found this round. Wall selection 'sticky' on the parent <g>: clicking on the bounding box outside the visible <line> doesn't fire the React onClick because the <g> has no fill — pointerEvents falls through to the SVG background. Mitigation: either set pointer-events='all' on the <g> or wrap walls in a transparent rect for hit testing.
